summary:
**ORBITFORGE – Interactive Space Mission Design and Simulation Platform**

ORBITFORGE is an interactive space mission design platform developed to help users understand, plan, and simulate scientific space missions. It addresses the challenge of balancing multiple mission requirements, including scientific objectives, spacecraft design, instruments, launch vehicles, budget, mass, power, communication, and orbital constraints.

The platform provides an engaging environment where users can explore mission planning, configure spacecraft components, manage mission resources, and understand the impact of engineering decisions. It aims to simplify complex aerospace concepts through interactive features, visualizations, and mission-related information.

ORBITFORGE is important because space mission planning requires careful coordination of scientific goals and engineering limitations. By making these concepts more accessible and interactive, the platform encourages creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and interest in space science and technology. It helps students and aspiring space enthusiasts gain a better understanding of how real-world scientific missions are designed.
details:
ORBITFORGE – Interactive Space Mission Design and Simulation Platform

1. What does the project do and how does it work?

ORBITFORGE is an interactive web-based platform designed to help users understand and explore the process of designing scientific space missions. It provides a structured environment where users can explore mission objectives, spacecraft configurations, scientific instruments, launch vehicles, budgets, mass, power requirements, communication systems, and orbital constraints.

The platform organizes complex mission-planning concepts into accessible sections, allowing users to explore different mission components and understand how engineering decisions influence the overall mission.

2. Benefits of the project

  • Simplifies complex space mission design concepts.
  • Helps students understand spacecraft engineering and mission planning.
  • Encourages practical learning through interactive features.
  • Improves critical thinking and engineering problem-solving skills.
  • Creates awareness about the challenges involved in real-world space missions.
  • Makes space science more accessible to beginners and enthusiasts.

3. Intended impact

The main objective of ORBITFORGE is to make space mission planning easier to understand, explore, and learn. It aims to encourage students and aspiring engineers to develop an interest in aerospace engineering, scientific exploration, and space technology.

In the long term, the platform can be expanded with advanced simulations, mission optimization, real scientific datasets, and AI-assisted recommendations to support more realistic mission-design experiences.

4. Tools and technologies used

The project was developed as a web-based application using:

  • HTML: For structuring the website and its pages.
  • CSS: For styling, layout, and responsive design.
  • JavaScript: For interactive elements and frontend functionality.
  • Visual Studio Code: As the development environment.
  • Git and GitHub: For version control and project management.

5. Creativity and innovation

ORBITFORGE combines space science, engineering concepts, and interactive web design into one learning platform. Instead of presenting mission-planning concepts only as theoretical information, it organizes them into an accessible digital experience.

Its modular design allows users to explore different aspects of a mission, understand their relationships, and develop their own understanding of the engineering decisions behind space exploration.

6. Factors considered by the team

While developing ORBITFORGE, we considered:

  • Scientific objectives and mission requirements.
  • Spacecraft mass and power limitations.
  • Instrument selection and scientific usefulness.
  • Launch vehicle capabilities.
  • Mission budget and resource management.
  • Communication and data transmission requirements.
  • Orbital constraints and mission feasibility.
  • User experience, accessibility, and ease of navigation.
  • Future scalability and opportunities for improvement.

Overall, ORBITFORGE aims to bridge the gap between theoretical space science and interactive mission-design learning, inspiring the next generation of space explorers and engineers.
